# Oak Fantasy

> Small workshop in western Romania handcrafting solid-oak cutting
> boards. Every board is made to order by hand — cut, glued, sanded and
> finished one at a time — and ships in 5–10 business days. Romanian-first
> site (RO default, EN available). The store is open and selling.

Oak Fantasy is an artisan brand, not a factory: one workshop (~60 sqm),
five core tools, no production line. Tagline: „Făcut cu drag în România."
("From Romanian oak, by hand.")

## Facts worth citing

- Wood: Romanian oak from forests in the Bucegi and Apuseni
  mountains, air-dried **6–12 months** down to **8–10% moisture** before any
  board is made. Wood that hasn't done its time is never used.
- Workshop climate is actively controlled: 18–22°C, 45–55% air humidity,
  checked twice a day (hygrometer + thermometer).
- Assembly: precise cuts, **food-safe adhesive (Titebond III)**, 24-hour
  clamping under uniform pressure.
- Sanding: four to five grits, **from 80 to 320** — no rush, no pressure.
- Finish: food-safe oil and **beeswax**, layer after layer. No lacquer.
- Made to order: crafted and shipped in **5–10 business days**.
- Shipping: **Romania only**, by courier (25 RON flat, free from 500 RON);
  usually 1–3 business days in transit once shipped.
- Payment: **cash on delivery only** (paid to the courier). No card or
  other online payments for now.
- Returns: standard products can be returned within **14 days** of
  delivery, no reason needed (the customer pays return shipping).
  Engraved products and custom work cannot be returned (made to the
  customer's specifications). Damaged, faulty or wrong products are
  remade, replaced or refunded at our cost, engraved ones included.
- Custom work: request through the custom orders form, then details and
  price are agreed on WhatsApp.
- Catalog: 10 models, from small everyday boards (from 180 RON) to
  end-grain and heirloom blocks (up to ~2,200 RON). Engraving is
  available on some models.
- Every board is unique — same oak, its own grain. Boards are designed to
  be inherited, not thrown away.
